about: How full mode starts, checks and seeds the Typesense stand-in (loop/full/unit.mjs). The service runs in a sandbox container of its own (gVisor, uid 65534, read-only root, no capability) at .<octet> of the run network, which has no way out; its data lives in the container's own /tmp and goes with it. {{api_key}} is a random value made for the unit; it is never a real credential. env_prefixes: the only server env names full mode sets (loop/full/env-wire.mjs); credentials: what a credential-like name is given. guard and fixture: the objects seed.mjs makes, which the thin declaration's guard and its read-only fixture resource name (loop/full/declare.mjs): the guard's text field carries a marker made for the unit, so the guard matches only when the server read this stand-in.
